source: Explicit clarification supplied by the user in chat on 2026-11-08; supersedes the earlier territory-presence interpretation.
movement: Moves resolve before Shield catches. Successful movers are immune, even between cells owned by the shielder.
blocked: A blocked or lost-contest move becomes an effective STAY and is catchable.
victims: Only rivals taking effective STAY on the shielder land; already-frozen players remain excluded.
backfire: No eligible catch freezes the shielder for the next two turns; normal Shield cooldown still applies.
other_rules: No changes to scoring, capture/upgrade work, full-land protection or input privacy.
